items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:92:1
items.html:
The general rule that emerges, that three aspects were divided, etc., and these two aspects, the first and the second, are not before the sin but aspect one, etc., the third is inferior to both of them, etc., the nine separate lower discernments in every Sefira: For before the sin there was in these hundred Ketarim the light of Yechida, as above, and therefore it includes within it all the NRNHY as one aspect, which are the two first aspects, namely the nine first ones of the lights in the hundred Ketarim, and the aspects of the lights of the souls that remained in them. But the third aspect, which is the nine first ones of the lights and the nine lower ones of the vessels, are discernments separate from one another, each one having a light separate and distinct from its fellow, for in the vessel of Hochma was the light of Haya, and in the vessel of Bina was the light of Neshama, etc.
And these three aspects that the ARI arranges here are worthy of deeper contemplation, for there is in them a great matter including and encompassing the entire wisdom, and therefore one must understand them with a fundamental understanding. And first one must understand what is the cause and the factor in the sin of the Tree of Knowledge, for the division of these three aspects in the soul of Adam HaRishon, in that the first aspect and the third were lost to him, and only the second aspect remained in him.
And to understand this, one must remember all that is explained above (page 658, the passage beginning “And One Must” — study it there well, throughout the continuation) about the three divisions that came out of the three aspects of the couplings in the world of Nekudim, which are: the first coupling, of the Katnut, and the two kinds of couplings of the Gadlut — the coupling of face to back, and the coupling of face to face. For from the vessels that remained of the two first couplings were corrected the GAR [first three] of Atzilut: Atik, AA and AVI, in a coupling that does not cease. And from the vessels that remained of the third coupling, which is face to face, were corrected ZON, and all the Mochin of the GAR that are not permanent, except that their coupling ceases, for they are dependent on the deeds of the lower ones: when they are worthy, they raise MAN [Mayin Nukvin] and cause Mochin in all the Partzufim of Atzilut, and when they are not worthy, immediately those Mochin are concealed and depart to their root. See there.
Also it was explained there, that the third division, from which are drawn the Mochin of Atzilut that are not permanent, divides itself into two aspects: a coupling that is complete but not entirely, and a coupling that is entirely complete. For as long as the Mochin are not permanent they are considered, from one side, a complete coupling, since those Mochin are fit for the birth of souls. And from the second side they are considered not entirely complete, because they are not permanent, and they are still dependent on the deeds of the lower ones. And the second aspect is at the end of the correction, when those Mochin will be permanent in the Partzufim, when they are discerned as a coupling that is entirely complete. See there. But the Mochin of the two first divisions, although their coupling does not cease, nevertheless are considered a coupling that is not complete, since they are not fit for the birth of souls, because they stand in the discernment of face to back, and their coupling has nothing but to sustain the worlds. See there, for it is impossible to double the length.
And you will understand here the three divisions which are in the ten Sefirot of Nekudim, and you will find that they are one matter with
the three aspects that the ARI wrote here in the soul of Adam HaRishon. For the first division, which is the aspect of the three Roshim that came out in the Katnut of Nekudim, each one in the discernment of Galgalta ve Einayim, in the lack of the AHP, which are: YESHSUT, which is from the Tabur and above, and the Keter of Nekudim, and the AVI of Nekudim. Behold, they are similar to the second aspect of the soul of Adam HaRishon, namely the aspect of the Katnut in the vessels of the Ketarim, which is GE, in the lights of Nefesh and Ruach of Keter; and the Ketarim themselves, which are the Roshim, are found lacking their GAR and their Mochin. And their nine lower ones, namely the ten Sefirot of the Guf from above downward, which are discerned as the nine lower in relation to the Rosh called Keter, behold, they have not yet come out at all at that time of the Katnut, as written in Part 7. Which is like the Ketarim of the soul of Adam HaRishon in the second aspect, where the Ketarim came out in the light of Nefesh, and the Ketarim are lacking the nine first ones, from Ruach and above, and the nine lower ones did not come out at all. Except that there is a difference in the Katnut itself, for in the Ketarim of Nekudim the Katnut came out in Nefesh and Ruach, and only the GAR are missing; but in the Ketarim of the soul of Adam HaRishon the Katnut came out in Nefesh alone, and the nine first ones are missing. And this is because in Nekudim the bottom Hey rose to the Einayim, and in Atzilut the bottom Hey rose to the forehead, as is known.
And the second division in the ten Sefirot of Nekudim, which is the Mochin of the discernment of face to back that they attained through the illumination of the Tabur, which brought the bottom Hey down from the Einayim and returned AVI to the Rosh of Keter, through which all the three Roshim attained the aspects of their AHP of vessels and the GAR of lights. Behold, this division is similar to the first aspect in the soul of Adam HaRishon, called the Zihara Ila'a [upper radiance], whose Ketarim attained the nine first ones of the lights in completeness, but they are still lacking their nine lower ones. And likewise there, in the ten Sefirot of Nekudim, only the Ketarim, which are the Roshim of Nekudim, were corrected by the Mochin of the second division, but to the ZAT nothing of these Mochin of face to back reached. As is known.
And the third division in the ten Sefirot of Nekudim, which are the Mochin that came out there upon the MAN of Vav and a point, from which the seven lower reigned and expanded to BYA, as is known, is similar to the third aspect in the soul of Adam HaRishon, which is the completion of the nine separate lower Sefirot in each and every Sefira of the Partzufim of his soul that are in BYA. For the lights of the two Roshim in Nekudim attained then their discernments from above downward, which are the ZAT of Nekudim, which expanded to the end of Assiya.
And with this you will understand, that in Atzilut, where only the two first divisions came out — the coupling of the Katnut, of the ascent of the bottom Hey to the forehead, where the light of Nefesh alone came out, which is the first division; and the coupling of the Gadlut, of the descent of the bottom Hey from the place of the forehead, which brought out the stature of Keter in Atik, Rosh and Guf, and the stature of Hochma in AA, Rosh and Guf, and the stature of Bina in AVI, Rosh and Guf — which is from the second division of Nekudim, of the discernment of the coupling of face to back, as above. Behold, they are discerned in this, that they are still lacking the aspects of their nine lower ones, which were in them at the time of Nekudim, namely the aforementioned third division. Except that in their Katnut, where the bottom Hey rose to the forehead, there was in them nothing but the aspect of the Nefesh of Keter, for the light of Nefesh came out in the Keter of the Keter of Atik, and the light of Nefesh came out in the Keter of Hochma in AA, and the light of Nefesh came out in the Keter of Bina in AVI. That is, exactly like the first division at the time of Nekudim, except that there, in the Ketarim, were the aspects of Nefesh and Ruach even at the time of the Katnut, because the bottom Hey rose to the Einayim, and two vessels remained in the Sefira of Keter, namely Galgalta and Einayim, which are phases one and two; and therefore there is there the stature of ZA, which is Ruach and Nefesh. And here, where the bottom Hey rose to the forehead, which is Galgalta, nothing came out there but the stature of Malchut, namely the light of Nefesh alone. And afterwards, in the coupling of the Gadlut of Atzilut, when through the coupling of AB SAG the bottom Hey returned and descended from the forehead, behold, the Ketarim of the GAR of Atzilut attained their NRNHY: for the Keter of Atik was completed in NRNHY, and likewise the Keter of Hochma in AA was completed in NRNHY, and likewise the Keter of Bina in AVI was completed in its NRNHY.
In this manner, all the permanent Mochin in the Partzufim of Atik and AA and AVI of Atzilut are nothing but the expansion of the Sefira of Keter alone, relative to what they were in Nekudim, where in the Katnut only the light of Nefesh of Keter came out in them, and in the Gadlut they attained all the NRNHY in Keter. And it is found that all the ten Sefirot of Atik are only the Keter of Atik, and its nine lower Sefirot are still missing. And likewise all the ten Sefirot of AA are only the Keter of AA, and the nine lower ones are missing. And likewise all the ten Sefirot of AVI are only their Keter, and they are missing their nine lower ones. That is, like the second division that was in Nekudim, and like the first aspect in the soul of Adam HaRishon. For these nine lower ones belong to the third division of Nekudim, namely from the MAN of Vav
and a point, which go and are clarified until the coming of Mashiach; and then the Partzufim of Atzilut will attain their nine lower Sefirot, and then the legs of Atzilut will expand to the end of Assiya, namely like they were in the third division at the time of the kings. This is what is called a coupling that is entirely complete, as above. And until then their correction is only by way of ascent, from the place of BYA to the place of Atzilut, and even this is not permanent, but dependent on the deeds of the lower ones.
Now we will understand the cause and the reason for the division of the soul of Adam HaRishon into three aspects, in that the first aspect and the third were lost to him, and only the second aspect remained in him, which is only the light of Nefesh in the hundred Ketarim. For it was explained that the permanent Mochin in the Partzufim of Atzilut are nothing but the aspects of the NRNHY of Keter in each Partzuf, but the nine lower ones of each Partzuf are missing in them, because they have nothing but from the first and second divisions of Nekudim, and the third division, which is the MAN of the nine lower ones, is missing in them, as above. And it is known that ZON cannot receive those permanent Mochin of face to back, which are from the second division, for even in Nekudim they had no share in them; and therefore they have nothing but the Katnut of the first division, and the Gadlut of the third division, namely only from the MAN of Vav and a point. And all the more so the soul of Adam HaRishon, which was emanated from ZON — certainly the Gadlut of the second division does not apply to it at all. And it is found that both the first aspect, which is the completion of the nine first ones of the Ketarim in him, and the third aspect, which is the nine lower Sefirot — both came out in him from the third division, and both are from the aspects of Mochin that are not permanent. And nothing is permanent in him, only the Katnut with which he came out at the beginning of his emanation, which is the aspect of the first division, namely the second aspect in his soul, which is the lights of the souls in his Ketarim.
In this manner, all the Gadlut that Adam HaRishon attained on the sixth day until dusk, when he had already clothed AA of Atzilut, which is the light of Yechida, by way of ascent — he attained then the NRNHY in the hundred Ketarim, which are called the Zihara Ila'a, and they are the Mochin that are destined to come to him on the Shabbat, from AK to all the ancients, which is the completion of the nine lower Sefirot in the hundred Partzufim, in the secret of Mati [reaching], legs in legs, which corrects BYA in their place, for the legs of Atzilut are drawn until this world, like the legs of AK, as above. Behold, all these ZON clarified for him from the MAN of Vav and a point. And this is what he said: “And there remained of those Ketarim only the light of Nefesh in them,” namely only the second aspect; but the NRNHY in the Ketarim, and all the more so the nine lower ones in the Partzufim, were lost to him because of the sin of the Tree of Knowledge, since they are from the aspects of the MAN of Vav and a point, which the lower ones are able to flaw, and their Mochin are not permanent. As explained.
And it is known, that the sin of Adam HaRishon caused a flaw in all the Partzufim of Atzilut, as the ARI wrote, and as written in the Tikkunim, that he placed darkness between the Cause of causes and the Keter (see in the Gate of Verses, Drush 2). And at first glance this is a contradiction to what the ARI wrote in several places, that all the flaw that the lower ones cause through their evil deeds does not reach the GAR, which are AA and AVI, but only ZON alone. As written (in Etz Chaim, Gate 11, Chapter 6). And how does he say here, that the sin of Adam HaRishon caused a flaw in all the worlds, that the Nukva of Atzilut descended to Beria, and ZA to his Nukva, and likewise in all those above him, that all of them descended from their degree (page 673, item 79; see there, and in the Inner Light). Behold, the deeds of the lower ones reach also the GAR. However, there is a great discernment here, namely between the permanent Mochin and the non-permanent ones. For what the ARI wrote, that the flaw that the lower ones cause through their evil deeds does not reach the GAR but ZON alone, is according to what Atzilut was corrected from the aspect of the new MA, permanently, from which came out the stature of Yechida in Atik, and the stature of Haya in AA, and the stature of Neshama in AVI. For they were corrected from the aspect of the second division, as above,
in which even ZON have no share. And all the more so for Adam HaRishon and all the souls of the lower ones, which come out only upon the MAN of Vav and a point, as above; and therefore the deeds of the lower ones do not reach the GAR at all. And what is written here, that the sin of Adam HaRishon brought down the Mochin even from the GAR — the ones in question are the additions of the Mochin that came out upon the MAN of Vav and a point, which ZON clarified and raised to AVI, and likewise AVI, upward, etc. As is known, that the Mochin of the lower one come from above downward, for there is no renewal of lights but from Ein Sof; and therefore they are necessarily revealed in the upper ones first. And moreover, the main light remains in the upper ones, and the lower one receives only the discernment of a branch from it. And it is found that all the Mochin that Adam HaRishon attained upon the MAN of Vav and a point — the main of those Mochin was revealed in the upper ones, for therefore all of them rose above their permanent degree: at the time of the birth of the soul, AVI rose to AA, and AA to Atik, etc. And at the time of the birth of the Haya of Adam HaRishon, AVI rose to Atik, and Atik rose upward into AK, etc., and so on in this manner.And these Mochin that the upper ones attained, which were drawn from the MAN of Vav and a point, are discerned in them as additions, and they are certainly dependent on the deeds of the lower ones, for they did not draw them for themselves but for the sake of the lower ones, and upon the aspects of the MAN that belongs to the lower ones. And therefore, at the time of the sin of Adam HaRishon, when he returned and cast down these MAN that were clarified for him from the Vav and a point, and mixed them among the Klipot [shells], he caused by this the departure of these Mochin from the upper ones, and all of them descended from their degree, for they rose there by the force of the couplings upon these MAN, and returned to their permanent degree in them, which is: the stature of Yechida to Atik, and the stature of Haya to AA, and the stature of Neshama to AVI. For to these Mochin the deeds of the lower ones do not reach at all.
However, ZON lost their Mochin entirely because of the sin of Adam HaRishon, and returned to the discernment of Katnut, which is back to back, drawn from the first division of Nekudim. This is because he has no share in the second division of Nekudim, from which the Mochin of Atik and AA and AVI of Atzilut were drawn, as above. And even the Mochin of his Neshama are drawn also only from the third division, namely from the MAN of Vav and a point, which are dependent on the deeds of the lower ones; and therefore all his Mochin departed entirely, at the time of the sin of Adam HaRishon, after he returned and mixed these MAN among the Klipot. As above. Behold, the GAR of Atzilut, which are Atik and AA and AVI — Adam HaRishon did not flaw anything in them by his sin, since they are permanent. But to ZON he caused a flaw, for all the Mochin departed from them, and they returned to their Katnut, to the discernment of back to back. And this is what he said, that the evil deeds of the lower ones do not reach at all the GAR of Atzilut, which are AA and AVI, but only the seven lower, which are ZON.
And there is one more very important foundation to contemplate here in the sin of Adam HaRishon: it is the third aspect in the soul of Adam HaRishon, which is the nine lower Sefirot in each Sefira of the ten Sefirot of every Partzuf of the five Partzufim in his soul, about which the ARI says, that they fell off him and fell into the depths of the Klipot. And behold, we explained above (page 679, the passage beginning “And We Found”), that they are the NRNHY that he was fit to attain on the Shabbat, from the aspect of AK, for everything that stands to be collected is considered as already collected. And although it is all true according to the matter, nevertheless one must ask according to this: why did these souls fall into the depths of the Klipot, since they had not yet come out in actuality?
And therefore one must necessarily understand the matters from their source. And you know, that this third aspect is drawn from the third division in the ten Sefirot of Nekudim, namely from the MAN of Vav and a point that AVI received from the Yesod of AK, in the aspect of the new light that descended from the coupling of AB SAG and breached the Parsa. Its meaning is, that it returned and nullified the boundary that was renewed by the second restriction,
and the worlds returned to the first boundary of the first restriction, which is the point of this world. For therefore the GAR and the ZAT came out there and expanded in BYA until the point of this world, and were completed even with the legs of AK. For here came out the completion of the nine lower Sefirot of the ten Sefirot of Nekudim, as written above (page 684, the passage beginning “And the Third Division”), that relative to this the five Partzufim of Atzilut are considered only an expansion of the NRNHY of the Ketarim, and the nine lower ones of each Partzuf are missing from them, as above. Which are the aspects of the ten Sefirot that expand to BYA, and are completed even with the legs of AK, like at the time of the kings, before they were broken, which is the secret of Mati, legs in legs.
And you should know, that the sin of Adam in eating from the Tree of Knowledge is one matter with the flaw that caused the breaking of the vessels, as the ARI wrote (in the Gate of Introductions, page 410, the passage beginning “And Since He Sinned” — study it there well). For the coupling is called eating; and since he felt in himself these Mochin that were fit to come to him on the Shabbat, which are in the aspects of Mati, legs in legs, as above, he did not wait any longer until the Shabbat, but drew those great Mochin of AK on the eve of Shabbat, namely he drew the illumination of Atzilut until the point of this world, for he wanted to attain his final completion immediately on the eve of Shabbat. And since he was not fit for this, therefore he cast down all these souls that he drew, into the Klipot. This is completely similar to the reign of the seven lower of Nekudim, that since they expanded in their reign in BYA, and the vessels were not yet clarified, therefore they fell to the Klipot of BYA. As this is well written in Part 7. Behold, the sin itself is the aspect of the exit of the nine lower ones, in each Sefira of the ten Sefirot of every Partzuf in the aspect of his soul, in actuality. And therefore they fell into the depths of the Klipot. And their correction will not be completed until the coming of Mashiach Ben David; and when they will be completed to come into the world and be corrected, then Mashiach Ben David will come.
